# Sporting News

> > Comprehensive sports news and analysis covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAA Basketball, Boxing, Formula 1, and international soccer.

Sporting News delivers breaking sports news, scores, schedules, and in-depth coverage across major American sports leagues (NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAA) and international competitions including the World Baseball Classic, March Madness, Formula 1, and global soccer. The platform serves multiple regions including the United States and Argentina, featuring expert analysis from journalists like Daniel Mader, Jake Mozarsky, and Dan Treacy.

## Key Topics

- NFL - National Football League coverage and news
- NBA - Basketball league updates and analysis
- MLB - Major League Baseball and World Baseball Classic
- NCAA Basketball - College basketball and March Madness tournament
- Boxing - Fight schedules, results, and IBF coverage
- Formula 1 - F1 racing news including Franco Colapinto
- World Baseball Classic - International baseball tournament featuring Team USA, Canada, Dominican Republic
- March Madness - NCAA tournament coverage
- Free Agency - NFL and NBA player signings and trades
- Team USA - National team coverage across multiple sports
- Soccer/Fútbol - International soccer including La Liga and Premier League
- Seattle Mariners - MLB team featuring Cal Raleigh
- Trade Rumors - Player movement and contract news
- Sports Betting - Analysis and odds coverage

## Main Hubs

- [Sporting News - NFL | NBA | MLB | NCAA | Boxing | Soccer | NASCAR](https://www.sportingnews.com/): Main homepage covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAA, World Baseball Classic & more
- [Breaking Sports News & Daily Updates | In-Depth Coverage](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/news): Breaking sports news: Real Madrid, La Liga, March Madness, Premier League
- [Sporting News Argentina - Fútbol | NBA | NFL | Boxeo | F1](https://www.sportingnews.com/ar/taxonomy/term/66593): Argentina homepage: Colapinto F1, NBA, NFL, boxing & soccer coverage
